fields.label: Warehouse
fields.description: Optional - leave blank for a default group that applies to every warehouse.

fields.label: Item Group
fields.description: Optional - leave blank to match every item group.

fields.label: Tolerance Percentage
fields.description: A variance within this percentage of the book quantity posts automatically. A variance against a zero book quantity never counts as within tolerance.

fields.label: Tolerance Quantity
fields.description: Optional absolute-quantity tolerance - a variance within this quantity also posts automatically, even if it exceeds the percentage tolerance.

fields.label: Requires Recount
fields.description: An out-of-tolerance variance is held for a recount before it can be posted or escalated for approval.

fields.label: Requires Supervisor Approval
fields.description: An out-of-tolerance variance (after a recount, if required) is held for supervisor approval before posting.
